Updates.NoRelease.zh: 还没有可用的发布版本

Updates.InstallFailed.zh: 更新未完成，已保留或恢复原版本。
Updates.InstallFailed.en: Update did not complete. The previous version was retained or restored.

Updates.PreviousInstallFailed.zh: 上次更新到 v{0} 未完成，请查看错误详情。
Updates.PreviousInstallFailed.en: The previous update to v{0} did not complete. See the details below.

Updates.ExitSaveFailed.zh: 无法保存当前画布，已取消更新。
Updates.ExitSaveFailed.en: Unable to save the current canvas. The update was cancelled.

Updates.NoNotes.zh: 这个版本没有提供更新说明。

Updates.Cancelled.zh: 已取消，当前版本可以继续使用
Updates.Cancelled.en: Cancelled. You can keep using the current version.

Updates.Restarting.zh: 正在安装，完成后将自动重启…

Updates.Development.zh: 无法安装更新。请确认程序文件完整，且当前账户可写入程序目录。修复后可重新检查。
Updates.Development.en: The update cannot be installed. Check that the package is complete and the application folder is writable, then check again.

Updates.InstallBlockedDetails.zh:
无法安装更新：{0}
修复后请重新检查，或将完整发行包解压到新目录。
Updates.InstallBlockedDetails.en:
The update cannot be installed: {0}
Fix the issue and check again, or extract the complete release into a new folder.

Updates.IncompletePackage.en: A package file is missing or empty: {0}

Updates.DirectoryAccessDenied.zh: 当前账户无权访问或写入程序目录。
Updates.DirectoryAccessDenied.en: Your Windows account cannot access or write to the application folder.

Updates.RequiresSetup.zh: 所有用户安装需要通过安装向导更新。
Updates.RequiresSetup.en: All-users installations must be updated through Setup.

Updates.OpenLinkFailed.zh: 无法打开 GitHub 链接
